messages:
maria (sec_eng): Auditor asked for a consolidated evidence package for the Mar 3 vuln triage incident — they want RBAC change history, audit logs showing key usage, and a chain-of-custody manifest. Can anyone run the export and confirm what we can include?

jamal (infra): I can run exports. Need exact time range and which clusters/accounts. Also: do we want raw CloudTrail/ELK snapshots or a filtered/scrubbed bundle?

maria (sec_eng): Time range: 2026-03-03T05:12:00Z to 2026-03-03T07:40:00Z. AFAIK the incident touched prod-us-east-1 and prod-eu-west-1. We should include:
- RBAC change events (k8s rolebinding/clusterrolebinding diffs + git PR links)
- KMS CloudTrail events for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/RotateKey for key IDs listed in the incident ticket
- SIEM search snapshot for suspicious access spikes
- Incident runbook + remediation PRs and who approved them

oliver (sre): For CloudTrail exports I usually run the lookup like this and then export to S3:```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-03-03T05:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-03T08:00:00Z --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt > ct_events.json
aws s3 cp ct_events.json s3://redwood-compliance-exports/5478901234/
```
I can do that and generate a presigned S3 link.

nina (sec_ops): Reminder: scrub any user-input PII from logs before handing to auditor. We have a scrubber script at internal:/infra/scripts/scrub-logs.sh — run it against the bundle. Also we need to keep copies for chain-of-custody.

auditor_kj: Can you confirm whether the CloudTrail entries include the KMS key ARN and the requestParameters that show ciphertextKeyId? Auditor needs proof that the key was used and whether the key version changed during the window. Also we need signed hashes for each artifact.

maria (sec_eng): Yes CloudTrail includes KMSKeyId and requestParameters in our setup. We'll include both raw CloudTrail JSON and a filtered CSV with columns: timestamp, eventName, userIdentity, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion, kmsKeyId, requestParameters. We'll also include terraform state PR and a screenshot of the key rotation workflow for the KMS key.

jamal (infra): I'll prepare the export. Steps I'll run: 1) run CloudTrail lookup and S3 export 2) export k8s audit logs for affected clusters (kubectl get events + audit log slice) 3) gather GitHub PRs and IAM policy diffs 4) run scrubber 5) generate manifest and sha256 sums.

maria (sec_eng): For sha256, we use:```bash
sha256sum artifact.tar.gz > artifact.tar.gz.sha256
```
Include manifest.json with entries like:
- artifact_name
- sha256
- created_by (runbook step)
- generated_by (username)
- notes (scrubbed yes/no)

evidence-bot: Automated note: evidence-bundle v0.9 will timestamp bundles and attach an immutable uuid. Run: `./scripts/evidence/export_bundle --ticket 5478 --out s3://redwood-compliance-exports/5478901234/`

auditor_kj: Will the manifest indicate whether logs are redacted or raw? We need chain-of-custody clarity (who produced the artifact and whether redaction was applied).

nina (sec_ops): Yes — manifest will have a field "redacted": true/false and "redaction_method": e.g., regex-scrub v1.2 or pii-scrubber. We'll also include a signed manifest: `gpg --detach-sign manifest.json` (we use our compliance key).

oliver (sre): One operational note — large CloudTrail exports from EU -> S3 in us-east have cross-region transfer considerations. I'll stage bundles in the same region bucket and then generate presigned links for auditor access.

maria (sec_eng): Action items: jamal to run exports and scrub by EOD today, oliver to produce presigned links, nina to produce signed manifest, maria to collate PRs/screenshots and upload. auditor_kj: does that timeline work?

auditor_kj: That works. Please include an index file mapping artifacts to SOC2 control IDs (CC6.1/CC7.2 etc.) and a short note for each artifact describing how it demonstrates the control. Example: `ct_events.json -> CC6.1 -> shows KMS decrypt events correlating to service-account decryption during incident` :thumbsup:

maria (sec_eng): Roger that — I'll add the control mapping CSV and upload to the bundle. I'll ping once presigned links are ready.
